definitions.explanation: describes intense heat, especially from the sun beating down
describes slow, steady movement or change, often with a sense of pressure or tension
describes a state of frustration or impatience while waiting

examples.japanese: ⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧じりじり⟦{照|て}りつける→照りつける：19550_teritsukeru⟧。
⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日差|ひざ}し→日差し：00107_hizashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧をじりじりと⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧。
examples.english: The summer sun scorches your skin.

examples.japanese: じりじりと⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The scorching hot days go on and on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧じりじり⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧じりじり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{迫|せま}って→迫る：03928_semaru⟧くる。
examples.english: The enemy is closing in slowly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{支持率|しじりつ}→支持率：17086_shijiritsu⟧がじりじりと⟦{下|さ}がっている→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: The approval rating is slipping little by little.

examples.english: The train didn't come, and everyone was growing impatient.

examples.english: I waited restlessly until the results came out.

notes:
USAGE:
All senses share an underlying tension or intensity - whether from heat, gradual pressure, or impatient waiting.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- じりじり⟦{照|て}りつける→照りつける：19550_teritsukeru⟧ (sun beats down scorchingly)
- じりじり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{迫|せま}る→迫る：03928_semaru⟧ (to close in gradually)
- じりじり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to feel restless/impatient)
